rca_of_the_issue: Register → Dashboard bug RCA: Register.jsx:26 calls `nav('/onboarding')` after successful register. Playwright framenavigated events confirm: URL becomes /onboarding then immediately changes to /dashboard. The only nav('/dashboard') call inside Onboarding.jsx is line 51 `if (st.data?.completed) nav('/dashboard')`. Backend /api/onboarding/status for a freshly registered user returns `{current_step:1, completed:false, ...}` — so this branch should NOT fire. Yet the redirect happens. Possible causes (for main agent to verify): (a) the cookie/auth header is not yet sent on the first /onboarding/status request, returning 401 which is silently caught — but the catch block doesn't redirect either; (b) some other component (AppShell?) reads st.data?.checks and force-redirects to dashboard if checks.first_agent is true (which IS true for new users since register seeds a default Customer Support Agent); (c) a race where `useAuth().user` is null for one render, triggering an unintended redirect somewhere. Recommend adding `console.log` traces in Onboarding.jsx:39-55 and any global guard, plus checking if AppShell or a layout component redirects when an onboarding 'check' is satisfied.
